scientific_limitations: Normal form and point count cover unital automorphisms of k[x,y]/(x^2,y^n) in characteristic two only for n>=3; the reduced automorphism variety and full tangent dimension are computed, not the nonreduced scheme coordinate algebra. An earlier 1997 year-only historical publication has no verified exact calendar-day publication evidence; the earliest day-verified foundational public source used for archival classification is arXiv:1401.0793v1 on 2014-01-04.
title: An unbounded infinitesimal symmetry excess for truncated complete intersections in characteristic two
